item.title: Coming From Sherman Oaks for a Haircut
item.description: A barbershop near Sherman Oaks does not have to be in Sherman Oaks. Amir Precision Cuts is a short hop west along Ventura Boulevard, at 17388 in Encino. For most men on the Sherman Oaks side the drive is under ten minutes, and it buys a single-barber chair instead of whoever is free. Ventura Boulevard is the whole route. item.title: Men's Haircuts in Encino: What $50 Actually Buys
item.description: A men's haircut in Encino is $50 at Amir Precision Cuts. That covers the consultation, the cut itself shaped to how your hair grows, and the neckline and edges finished by hand at the end. It is one price rather than a starting point, and it is the same on a Tuesday as it is on a Saturday. Price pages tend to describe a haircut with adjectives. item.title: A Barber a Short Walk From the Encino Oak Tree
item.description: Amir Precision Cuts sits on Ventura Boulevard in Encino, a few minutes on foot from the Encino Oak Tree and just west of Louise Avenue. Anyone already on that stretch — working there, running errands, walking back from Encino Park — can reach the chair without getting into a car. Appointments run Tuesday to Saturday.
